images.after_paragraph: For a moment he could not remember which world he was on. There had been glass in front of him, white fire beyond it, his mother's hand pulling a strap across his wrist. His father had been saying something ordinary. The dream never let him hear the end of it.
images.alt: Young Arin watches his mother fasten his wrist strap; his father is reflected in the spacecraft window beside a white flash.

images.after_paragraph: He almost told her that he was not accustomed to being ordered around by strangers. This would have been a lie, given his profession, and she looked capable of noticing it. He found a maintenance panel strong enough to carry a man. Together they shifted the strut and settled the surveyor on it.
images.alt: Arin and Mira carry an injured surveyor on a maintenance panel through the flooded waterworks.

images.after_paragraph: Arin obeyed because the order made sense.
images.alt: Arin and Orin defend the evacuation route while Mira tends a passenger and a Kynari engineer repairs the connection.

images.after_paragraph: Afterward, Zara played his recorded sleep utterance through a speaker. Nothing happened. She adjusted the volume, confirmed the signal, and played it again.
images.alt: Zara operates a recording device beside a still bowl of water while Arin and Mira watch.

images.after_paragraph: Zara closed the audio. She left the record visible because hiding it now would imply another kind of control she had no right to exercise.
images.alt: Arin studies the image of his parents’ ship on a combat-record display, with Zara beside him.

images.after_paragraph: Kael explained his calculations. The likelihood of continued cycles of conflict and decline, the possibility of conditions in which involuntary suffering might be reduced beyond anything obtainable through local intervention, the terrible scale of lives still to come. He heard himself growing more precise as the listeners became less persuaded.
images.alt: Kael bows his head over the Second Dawn model while Mira, Zara, Milo and Orin consider its cost.

images.after_paragraph: The movement surprised them both. His father did not exploit it by reaching for a reconciliation neither had offered.
images.alt: Orin and his father sit across a wooden table; his father’s military coat hangs behind them.

images.after_paragraph: Orin helped secure the physical nodes. Arin carried equipment without asking whether it was an efficient use of cosmic potential. Mira monitored the field's effect on temperature and pressure in a test chamber before permitting biological exposure.
images.alt: Milo and Zara check the route and timing equipment while Arin, Mira and Orin prepare the crossing.

images.after_paragraph: The name awakened no remembered face. Kael was grateful for that. Too much else felt like recognition without a source.
images.alt: Four-armed Aevos stands above the reflective plane, holding world displays and hourglass-like instruments around a bright chest connection.

images.after_paragraph: Tomorrow was not guaranteed. It was being prepared, quietly, by people who expected him to be there. Kael listened to Mira set down the clean water, felt Arin's fingers settle more securely around his own, and allowed the unfinished world to continue without his watching it.
images.alt: Kael rests in bed as Mira tends his chest dressing and Arin holds his bare hand during his recovery.
